Validation frame —

Real validation images with actual U-Net outputs (128 × 128, enlarged). Replayed with travel distance; not the rover’s live view or the same DTM location.

Measured confusion matrix · epoch 9

Rows: true class. Columns: predicted class. Percent of valid pixels; 182 validation images.

Scope & provenance
Terrain coloring is simulated from DTM geometry and the measured confusion matrix. U-Net is not applied directly to orbital data.

DTM grid: 1 m (resampled from ~1.012 m). Rocks smaller than 1 m are not represented in this data.

This demo is a geometric illustration, not a dynamics simulation. Obstacle classes and impacts are proxies, not identified real rocks or physical collision forces.
